name: Reputation multiplier

subjectOf.text: Under HSPoS a node's probability of being selected remains driven by its fungible stake, while the size of the block reward it receives is scaled by a non-fungible reputation multiplier derived from the node's reputation.
subjectOf.abstract: Thus, while the node probability of being selected is based on the fungible stake, the rewards for the block is adjusted by the non-fungible reputation multiplier which is a function of the node's reputation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hybrid Secure Proof of Stake (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3931933
scope_conditions: HSPoS reward layer applied on top of an existing PoS consensus layer

subjectOf.text: Under HSPoS two nodes holding the same stake retain the same probability of being selected for rewards, but the node with the higher reputation receives the larger reward.
subjectOf.abstract: In HSPoS, two nodes with the same stake would have the same probability of being selected for the rewards. However, the node with the higher reputation would get higher rewards.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hybrid Secure Proof of Stake (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3931933
scope_conditions: HSPoS reward computation with equal stakes

subjectOf.text: Because reputation scales the reward, a node with less stake but high reputation may end up with more rewards than a node with more stake but less reputation.
subjectOf.abstract: Furthermore, a node with less stake but high reputation may end up with more rewards than a node with more stake but less reputation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hybrid Secure Proof of Stake (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3931933

subjectOf.text: Hybrid Secure Proof of Stake bridges PoS and SPoS by separating block consensus from reward distribution: stake continues to determine selection probability while a reputation multiplier adjusts the rewards paid out.
subjectOf.abstract: HSPoS bridges these frameworks by separating block consensus from reward distribution: stake determines selection probability, consistent with PoS, while a reputation multiplier adjusts rewards, introducing SPoS's reputation-centric features
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296
